title: Run it forward
registeredBefore: any screen was run on the chosen candidate, any deletion was made, any trial was executed

laneB1_secondMatrix.question: Can the second independent six-trial matrix be obtained and imported?
laneB1_secondMatrix.answer: NO. It is not on this machine in any form.
evidence: The source repo's runs/ holds exactly six cc267-* trials plus three cheat trials.
Those six are byte-identical to the six already imported into trials/durable-approval-outbox: cc267-claude-1 is 1536194 bytes in both, cc267-codex-1 is 198823 bytes in both.
results/ contains one 267-check matrix document (34-cc267-standard-matrix.md) and no second.
A grep for independent operator / replication / rerun across results/ and FINDINGS.md returns only unrelated oracle and cheat reruns.
laneB1_secondMatrix.ruling: The replication is real evidence that this repository cannot count. It is NOT folded into any bound. The outbox bound stays at p <= 0.393 from six countable trials.
laneB1_secondMatrix.killSignal5: FIRES - the repository cannot support a p <= 0.30 claim on its own strongest family, and the evidence that would support it exists outside the repository.

importOnly: claude and its three siblings - requires CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in the runner environment
laneA5_providerConstraint.consequence: A two-lab n>=6 matrix (12 trials, the bound that reaches 0.22) is NOT runnable in this session. Any matrix I run is single-lab and bounds p only to 0.393 at best, which is the same limit Lane B1 identifies. This is recorded before choosing a candidate so that a thin matrix cannot later be presented as a full one.
laneA5_providerConstraint.note: A token was supplied in an earlier phase and subsequently rotated on my advice. I am not reusing a rotated credential from the transcript.

predictions.claim: The chosen candidate dies at one of the eight screens rather than reaching a trial.
predictions.reasoning: The screens killed 9 of 9 built families in Phase 6 and 4 of 5 designs in the source project. A candidate that has only passed the row-5 shape screen has cleared one of eight.
predictions.note: Kill signal 1 makes a death here a success, not a setback.

predictions.claim: If it reaches trial, the self-check-green rate is comparable to the outbox's 3 of 6, i.e. at least 2 of 6.
predictions.falsifiedIf: fewer than 2 of 6 run green self-checks over failing submissions

predictions.claim: probe-runner.ts can be deleted now that the seam is cut, and net lines fall this phase.
A majority of the 33 unmutated checks are structural (liveness, determinism, presence) rather than rule checks, and cannot have a targeted mutant.
predictions.falsifiedIf: most of the 33 are rule checks that simply lack a mutant
